description: Renovate keeps every dependency current: the npm packages (the workspaces share one lockfile), the GitHub Actions and the Dockerfile's base image. `npm run check` in CI decides whether an update lands.
The shared preset sends npm minors and patches as one weekly PR, the Actions as another, and holds majors on the Dependency Dashboard for a tick.

A new release of ghcr.io/foreverworks/node within the same line merges on its own once the required checks pass, ci's image build among them (the base-images preset); a new Node major is a PR for a person.

packageRules.description: A vendor release can add tools, and porkbun's policy stops the server on a tool it has not classified, so this one is bumped by hand with its classification (servers/porkbun/README.md).
The types follow the oldest Node the packages accept (engines), not the newest Node.
